verses.text_en: In the thirtieth year after the ruin of the city I was in Babylon, and lay troubled upon my bed, and my thoughts came up over my heart:
verses.text_hr: Tridesete godine nakon propasti grada bio sam u Babilonu. Ležao sam uznemiren na svojoj postelji, a misli su mi se rojile u srcu.

verses.text_en: For I saw the desolation of Sion, and the wealth of them that dwelt at Babylon.
verses.text_hr: Jer sam vidio pustoš Siona i bogatstvo onih koji su živjeli u Babilonu.

verses.text_en: And my spirit was sore moved, so that I began to speak words full of fear to the most High, and said,
verses.text_hr: I moj je duh bio jako ganut, tako da sam počeo govoriti riječi pune straha Svevišnjem, i rekao sam,

verses.text_en: O Lord, who bearest rule, thou spakest at the beginning, when thou didst plant the earth, and that thyself alone, and commandedst the people,
verses.text_hr: O Gospodine, Vladaru, ti si govorio na početku, kada si sâm zasadio zemlju i zapovjedio narodu,

verses.text_en: And gavest a body unto Adam without soul, which was the workmanship of thine hands, and didst breathe into him the breath of life, and he was made living before thee.
verses.text_hr: I dao si Adamu tijelo bez duše, koje je bilo djelo tvojih ruku, i udahnuo si mu dah života, i oživio je pred tobom.

verses.text_en: And thou leadest him into paradise, which thy right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward.
verses.text_hr: A ti ga vodiš u raj, koji je tvoja desnica zasadila, prije nego što je zemlja iznikla.

verses.text_en: And unto him thou gavest commandment to love thy way: which he transgressed, and immediately thou appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.
verses.text_hr: Dao si mu zapovijed da ljubi tvoj put; on ju je prekršio, pa si odmah odredio smrt njemu i njegovim naraštajima, od kojih su potekli bezbrojni narodi, plemena, puci i rodovi.

verses.text_en: And every people walked after their own will, and did wonderful things before thee, and despised thy commandments.
verses.text_hr: I svaki je narod hodio po svojoj volji i činio divna djela pred tobom, i prezirao je tvoje zapovijedi.

verses.text_en: And again in process of time thou broughtest the flood upon those that dwelt in the world, and destroyedst them.
verses.text_hr: I opet si tijekom vremena pustio potop na one koji su živjeli u svijetu i uništio ih.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass in every of them, that as death was to Adam, so was the flood to these.
verses.text_hr: Svakomu se od njih dogodilo isto: kao što je Adamu došla smrt, tako je njima došao potop.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless one of them thou leftest, namely, Noah with his household, of whom came all righteous men.
verses.text_hr: Ipak si ostavio jednoga od njih, naime Nou s domom njegovim, od kojih su potekli svi pravednici.

verses.text_en: And it happened, that when they that dwelt upon the earth began to multiply, and had gotten them many children, and were a great people, they began again to be more ungodly than the first.
verses.text_hr: Kad su se stanovnici zemlje počeli množiti, dobili su mnogo djece i postali velik narod, ali su ponovno postali bezbožniji od svojih prethodnika.

verses.text_en: Now when they lived so wickedly before thee, thou didst choose thee a man from among them, whose name was Abraham.
verses.text_hr: Sad kad su živjeli tako opako prije tebe, ti si između njih izabrao sebi čovjeka po imenu Abraham.

verses.text_en: Him thou lovedst, and unto him only thou shewedst thy will:
verses.text_hr: Njega si volio, i samo njemu si iskazao svoju volju:

verses.text_en: And madest an everlasting covenant with him, promising him that thou wouldest never forsake his seed.
verses.text_hr: I sklopio s njim vječni savez, obećavši mu da nikada nećeš napustiti njegovo potomstvo.

verses.text_en: And unto him thou gavest Isaac, and unto Isaac also thou gavest Jacob and Esau. As for Jacob, thou didst choose him to thee, and put by Esau: and so Jacob became a great multitude.
verses.text_hr: I njemu si dao Izaka, a Izaku si dao i Jakova i Ezava. Što se tiče Jakova, ti si ga izabrao sebi i postavio uz Ezava; i tako je Jakov postao veliko mnoštvo.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass, that when thou leadest his seed out of Egypt, thou broughtest them up to the mount Sinai.
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se da kad si izveo njegovo potomstvo iz Egipta, doveo si ih na brdo Sinaj.

verses.text_en: And bowing the heavens, thou didst set fast the earth, movedst the whole world, and madest the depths to tremble, and troubledst the men of that age.
verses.text_hr: I sagnuvši nebesa, ti si učvrstio zemlju, pokrenuo si cijeli svijet i učinio da zadrhtaju dubine i uznemirio si ljude onoga doba.

verses.text_en: And thy glory went through four gates, of fire, and of earthquake, and of wind, and of cold; that thou mightest give the law unto the seed of Jacob, and diligence unto the generation of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Tvoja je slava prošla kroz četvera vrata — ognja, potresa, vjetra i studeni — da predaš Zakon Jakovljevu potomstvu i revnost Izraelovu naraštaju.

verses.text_en: And yet tookest thou not away from them a wicked heart, that thy law might bring forth fruit in them.
verses.text_hr: Ipak im nisi oduzeo zlo srce kako bi tvoj Zakon u njima donosio plod.

verses.text_en: For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.
verses.text_hr: Prvi Adam nosio je zlo srce, sagriješio i bio svladan; isto se dogodilo svima koji su od njega rođeni.

verses.text_en: Thus infirmity was made permanent; and the law (also) in the heart of the people with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still.
verses.text_hr: Tako je slabost postala trajna, a Zakon je ostao u srcu naroda zajedno sa zloćom korijena; dobro je iščeznulo, a zlo je ostalo.

verses.text_en: So the times passed away, and the years were brought to an end: then didst thou raise thee up a servant, called David:
verses.text_hr: Vremena su prolazila i godine došle do kraja; tada si sebi podigao slugu po imenu David.

verses.text_en: Whom thou commandedst to build a city unto thy name, and to offer incense and oblations unto thee therein.
verses.text_hr: Kome si zapovjedio da sagradi grad tvome imenu i da ti u njemu prinosi tamjan i darove.

verses.text_en: When this was done many years, then they that inhabited the city forsook thee,
verses.text_hr: Mnogo godina nakon toga stanovnici toga grada napustili su te,

verses.text_en: And in all things did even as Adam and all his generations had done: for they also had a wicked heart:
verses.text_hr: I u svemu su činili kao što su činili Adam i svi njegovi naraštaji: jer i oni su imali opako srce:

verses.text_en: And so thou gavest thy city over into the hands of thine enemies.
verses.text_hr: I tako si predao svoj grad u ruke svojih neprijatelja.

verses.text_en: Are their deeds then any better that inhabit Babylon, that they should therefore have the dominion over Sion?
verses.text_hr: Jesu li djela stanovnika Babilona išta bolja da bi zbog toga imali vlast nad Sionom?

verses.text_en: For when I came thither, and had seen impieties without number, then my soul saw many evildoers in this thirtieth year, so that my heart failed me.
verses.text_hr: Kad sam došao onamo i vidio bezbrojne opačine, moja je duša u ovoj tridesetoj godini vidjela mnoge zločince, te me srce izdalo.

verses.text_en: For I have seen how thou sufferest them sinning, and hast spared wicked doers: and hast destroyed thy people, and hast preserved thine enemies, and hast not signified it.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam kako trpiš da griješe i štediš zlotvore; uništio si svoj narod, sačuvao svoje neprijatelje, a nisi objavio razlog.

verses.text_en: I do not remember how this way may be left: Are they then of Babylon better than they of Sion?
verses.text_hr: Ne razumijem kako se taj poredak može održati. Jesu li Babilonci bolji od Sionaca?

verses.text_en: Or is there any other people that knoweth thee beside Israel? or what generation hath so believed thy covenants as Jacob?
verses.text_hr: Ili ima li još koji narod koji te poznaje osim Izraela? Ili koji je naraštaj vjerovao savezima tvojim kao Jakov?

verses.text_en: And yet their reward appeareth not, and their labour hath no fruit: for I have gone here and there through the heathen, and I see that they flow in wealth, and think not upon thy commandments.
verses.text_hr: Pa ipak, njihova se nagrada ne vidi i njihov trud nema ploda. Prošao sam među narodima i vidim da obiluju bogatstvom, a na tvoje zapovijedi ne misle.

verses.text_en: Weigh thou therefore our wickedness now in the balance, and their’s also that dwell the world; and so shall thy name no where be found but in Israel.
verses.text_hr: Izvagni zato na vagi našu zloću i zloću onih koji prebivaju u svijetu; tada se tvoje ime neće naći nigdje osim u Izraelu.

verses.text_en: Or when was it that they which dwell upon the earth have not sinned in thy sight? or what people have so kept thy commandments?
verses.text_hr: Je li ikada bilo doba kada stanovnici zemlje nisu sagriješili pred tobom? Ili koji je narod tako čuvao tvoje zapovijedi?

verses.text_en: Thou shalt find that Israel by name hath kept thy precepts; but not the heathen.
verses.text_hr: Vidjet ćeš da je Izrael po imenu držao tvoje zapovijedi; ali ne i pogani.
